summary: Thin fast (query,chunk) relevance scorer: distill the proven zero-shot signal into a lean-box model
description:
Rung 3 of the scorer ladder, reframed after the 2026-08-12 measurements: distill bge-reranker-v2-m3 zero-shot (which passed the EDGE_RERANK ship gate on quality: 72.7% strict vs 62.5% baseline, kappa +1.0) into a model small and fast enough for the lean box.

Owner intent: good data generation makes it faster and thinner — this was the original hope of the project.

Design constraints settled by the measurement record (docs/edges/query-scorer-rungs.md + addenda, runs/edges/relevance-judge/2026-08-12T{12-49-14,18-14-23,19-12-02}Z):
- Architecture class: tiny CROSS-encoder. Bi-encoder cosine is disqualified for selection (four independent confirmations of the ceiling; its re-run AUC 0.686 is query-mix-dependent and collapses on specific-concept queries).
- Data: teacher = bge fp32 logits at scale (no grading needed); gold = blind double-graded subsets under the proven (query,chunk) frame (kappa +0.800/+0.868/+1.000) for calibration and eval only.
- Query distribution: trainable-work golden queries + ritual-style synthetic queries. WORK-DISJOINT DISCIPLINE: queries from frozenEval:true works never appear in training — they are the eval set. Provenance manifest mandatory.
- Serving constraint (owner, 2026-08-12): no added CPU pressure in the RAG step. Primary deployment is offline edge curation and optional async scoring; synchronous enable only if the owner accepts the measured cost at ship gate.
- GPU (3090) for teacher batches and training needs per-run owner permission; announce on start, release after.
- Quality bar to preserve: surfaced-stratum AUC >= 0.74 (zero-shot bge) and ship-gate kept-slot strict >= baseline, on frozen-work queries.
